first_before.welcome: You are looking at the CDISC pilot study, a public demo: 254 participants, 18 charts on five tabs. To use your own files, open Data. They are read in this browser and never leave it.

first.title: Histogram · safety.viz demo
first.status_counts: 13 charts are Exploratory. 5 charts and the RBQM tab are Experimental
first.study_note: 254 participants from the CDISC pilot study, with standard column names. The labs file also carries 110 synthetic liver and kidney participants who are in no other file.
